title: Spectrum Cruise
generation_prompt: Create an original 180-second stereo synthwave instrumental at a steady 114 BPM in 4/4 for a family-friendly one-or-two-key rhythm game. By 24 seconds the full driving chorus is active: punchy quarter-note electronic kick, dry backbeat snare, crisp eighth hats, rolling analog octave bass, warm wide vintage chords and a short lead-synth attack each quarter beat. Signature melody: a four-note ascending saw line followed by a three-note bell answer, with altered bass roots and the answer inverted after 96 seconds. Maintain a complete arrangement and stable dance loudness from 32 through 160 seconds. Bright retro-electronic atmosphere but no imitation of any known melody. No vocals, speech, samples, tempo drift, sparse bridge, fade, silent stretch or harsh clipping in the selected passage.
cover_prompt: Original high-contrast comic-print cover: five parallel frequency bands curve around an open cyan prism channel with a small coral bearing marker; no vehicle, road, sun, character or text.
og_prompt: Wide duohertz card with curved spectrum bands on right and Spectrum Cruise title left.
